description: This file is a Java source file for an Android application's camera fragment. It manages camera setup, preview, focus, capture, and save functionalities for the Camera2 API, and includes UI interactions such as taking pictures and showing info dialogs.

classes.name: Camera2BasicFragment
classes.description: Main class handling camera operations, preview, capturing images, and UI interactions in an Android application using Camera2 API.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator for comparing Android Sizes based on their area.

classes.name: ErrorDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment class to show error messages related to camera support or permissions.

classes.name: ConfirmationDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment class to show permission request confirmations.

classes.name: ImageSaver
classes.description: Runnable class responsible for saving images from ImageReader to disk.
